$comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for technical naming in MUSIC OS 360. Edit this file only. docs/NAMING_NORMALIZATION_CANONICAL_MAP.md and docs/NAMING_NORMALIZATION_STATUS.md are GENERATED from it by scripts/naming/render-naming-docs.mjs (CI: --check). Narrative background lives in docs/naming/decision-records.md (non-authoritative).

conventions.languageRule: Engineering = English (files, folders, modules, symbols, DTOs, schemas, events, queues, jobs, routes, tables, columns, migrations, test descriptions, technical comments, technical docs, env/config keys, i18n keys). Portuguese only in what the end user sees in the frontend (labels, titles, messages, placeholders, tooltips, visible errors, buttons, options, confirmations) and in tests that assert that visible text.
conventions.acronyms: Acronyms and abbreviations are cased as words inside identifiers: Dto, Id, Url, Api, Uuid, Json, Http, Ai, Hr, Crm, Rbac, Kpi, Isrc, Upc, Ecad, Pdf (measured 2026-09-26: Dto 1782 vs DTO 5, Id 14975 vs ID 0, Url 1747 vs URL 87 (mostly the URL global), Api 2613 vs API 3, Ai 386 vs AI 219, Hr 42 vs HR 1, Crm 213 vs CRM 93, Isrc 111 vs ISRC 33). ALL-CAPS only in SCREAMING_SNAKE constants and env vars, and in library-defined names (IsUUID, ParseUUIDPipe, URL, JSON, URLSearchParams).

pluralization.controllerServiceRepository: plural resource + role (ArtistsController, ArtistsService); single-purpose services are named by responsibility (ReleaseReadinessService)
pluralization.component: singular PascalCase for a single record (ReleaseFormModal, ContactViewModal); plural for list pages (Releases.tsx)
pluralization.hook: use + plural for collections (useReleases), use + singular for one record (useRelease)
pluralization.queueJobName: kebab-case (ai-jobs, integrations-sync; job names kebab or <provider>:<action>)
pluralization.testDescription: English behavior sentence; quoted Portuguese only for the user-visible text being asserted (it("shows 'Salvar projeto' when editing a project"))

glossary.definition: A music or audiovisual production effort owned by a tenant (projects / audiovisual_projects / marketing_projects are distinct aggregates — qualify when ambiguous: AudiovisualProject, MarketingProject).
disallowedUsages: bare 'project' for marketing or audiovisual work
glossary.idNamespace: projectId = projects.id (tenant-scoped uuid); audiovisual/marketing projects use audiovisualProjectId / marketingProjectId

glossary.definition: A performer/creator managed by the tenant (artists table). Identity on external platforms is an ArtistPlatformProfile, never the artist id itself.
disallowedUsages: artistId holding a provider/platform id — use <provider>ArtistId or externalId
glossary.idNamespace: artistId = artists.id (internal uuid). External ids are namespaced: spotifyArtistId, soundchartsArtistUuid, youtubeChannelId, instagramUserId

glossary.definition: A MUSIC release (single/EP/album) distributed to DSPs (releases table, ReleaseEntity). Portuguese UX: 'Lançamento'. Not a software release and not an accounting entry.
disallowedUsages: 'release' for deployments (use 'deployment'/'appRelease') and 'lancamento' for ledger entries (use 'transaction')
glossary.idNamespace: releaseId = releases.id; distributor-side ids: <distributor>ReleaseId, upc

glossary.definition: One recording inside a release or project (release tracks, project_tracks). Portuguese UX: 'Faixa'/'Música'.
disallowedUsages: 'music'/'song' as structural names
glossary.idNamespace: projectTrackId = project_tracks.id; isrc identifies the recording externally

glossary.definition: A musical composition (works table) — the copyright in the song. Portuguese UX: 'Obra'.
disallowedUsages: 'song' for the composition
glossary.idNamespace: workId = works.id; iswc and society work codes are external

glossary.definition: A sound recording of a work (phonograms table) — the master/recording right. Portuguese UX: 'Fonograma'.
disallowedUsages: 'recording' as a table/FK name (no recordings table exists)
glossary.idNamespace: phonogramId = phonograms.id; isrc external

glossary.definition: A legal agreement managed in contracts (artist/client/licensing agreements, signed via Autentique/DocuSign).
disallowedUsages: 'contract' for API/type contracts in domain code — use 'apiContract'/'schema'
glossary.idNamespace: contractId = contracts.id; provider document ids: autentiqueDocumentId / docusignEnvelopeId (stored as autentique_doc_id / metadata.provider_doc_id)

glossary.definition: A financial ledger entry (transactions v1; financial_transactions v2 scaffolded). Portuguese UX: 'Lançamento financeiro'/'Transação'.
disallowedUsages: 'transaction' for DB transactions in domain names — use 'dbTransaction'/'manager'
glossary.idNamespace: transactionId = transactions.id (v1 ledger)

glossary.definition: A billing document: tenant fiscal invoices (NFS-e, type != stripe_subscription) or SaaS Stripe invoices (type = stripe_subscription) in the same invoices table — always qualify (FiscalInvoice / StripeSubscriptionInvoice) when the distinction matters.
disallowedUsages: treating both invoice kinds as one concept in dunning
glossary.idNamespace: invoiceId = invoices.id; stripeInvoiceId for SaaS invoices

glossary.definition: The tenant's SaaS plan subscription with the platform (billing_subscriptions, Stripe).
disallowedUsages: 'subscription' for realtime/event subscriptions without qualification
glossary.idNamespace: billing_subscriptions.id; stripeSubscriptionId; scoped by orgId

glossary.definition: A client of the tenant (clients table). Portuguese UX: 'Cliente'/'Contato'. The Stripe customer of the platform is 'stripeCustomer'.
disallowedUsages: bare 'customer' for the Stripe customer
glossary.idNamespace: clientId = clients.id (tenant customer); stripeCustomerId = the platform customer in Stripe

glossary.definition: Never bare. Qualify: userAccount (auth identity), billingAccount/stripeCustomer (SaaS billing), socialAccount/oauthConnection (connected provider login), societyAccount (collecting society), bankAccount (payout).
disallowedUsages: bare 'account'
glossary.idNamespace: never bare accountId: societyAccountId, stripeCustomerId, oauthConnectionId, bankAccountId

glossary.definition: The isolation boundary for business data (tenants table, tenant_id, RLS app_current_tenant_id()).
disallowedUsages: 'user' or 'account' meaning tenant
glossary.idNamespace: tenantId = tenants.id (RLS key app_current_tenant_id())

glossary.definition: The owner of one or more tenants (organizations table, org_id); billing and subscription are org-scoped.
disallowedUsages: 'company' for this boundary
glossary.idNamespace: orgId = organizations.id (RLS key app_current_org_id())

glossary.definition: Product term for the org+tenant pair created at signup (WorkspaceProvisioningService). Not a separate table.
disallowedUsages: using 'workspace' as a third isolation key
glossary.idNamespace: no own id: a workspace is (orgId, tenantId)

glossary.definition: An authenticated person (users table, auth_user_id); tenant membership is an OrgMember/membership with a role.
disallowedUsages: 'user' meaning tenant or member role
glossary.idNamespace: userId = users.id (internal); authUserId = identity-provider (Supabase auth) user id

glossary.definition: A user's membership in an org/tenant with a role (org_members).
disallowedUsages: 'user' when the membership is meant
glossary.idNamespace: memberId = org_members.id

glossary.definition: A CRM prospect not yet converted (leads table). Portuguese UX: 'Lead'.
disallowedUsages: 'contact' for leads
glossary.idNamespace: leadId = leads.id

glossary.definition: A CRM contact, physically a clients row ('Contato = Cliente', ContactsService facade over ClientsService).
disallowedUsages: 'contact' for a lead or for artist team contacts (ArtistTeamContact)
glossary.idNamespace: contactId = clientId (same clients row)

glossary.definition: A marketing campaign (campaigns table).
disallowedUsages: 'campaign' for lead conditional payloads without qualification
glossary.idNamespace: campaignId = campaigns.id

glossary.definition: Delivery of a release to DSPs through a distributor (release status DISTRIBUTED, distributor). Portuguese UX: 'Distribuição'.
disallowedUsages: 'distribution' for statistical distributions in domain code
glossary.idNamespace: distributor ids are namespaced per distributor

glossary.definition: Income owed to rights holders from exploitation of works/phonograms.
disallowedUsages: 'royalty' for platform fees

glossary.definition: A percentage share of rights/royalties (shares table: party_role, percentage). Portuguese UX: 'Share'/'Rateio'.
disallowedUsages: 'split' for string splitting in domain names
glossary.idNamespace: shareId = shares.id

glossary.definition: Money movement settling an invoice/transaction (payment_events for Stripe; transaction payment fields).
disallowedUsages: 'payment' for the SaaS subscription itself
glossary.idNamespace: payment_events.stripe_event_id (Stripe event), transaction payment fields

glossary.definition: The platform's SaaS billing of tenants (billing_* tables, Stripe, dunning via tenant_billing_state).
disallowedUsages: 'billing' for the tenant's own invoicing of its customers (use 'invoicing')
glossary.idNamespace: tenant_billing_state keyed by tenantId; billing_subscriptions by orgId

glossary.definition: An external music/social platform (Spotify, YouTube, Instagram, ...) where an artist has a profile (artist_platform_profiles).
disallowedUsages: 'platform' for the MUSIC OS 360 product itself (use 'app'/'system')
glossary.idNamespace: platform = enum key (spotify, youtube, instagram, ...); platform-side ids are <platform>...Id

glossary.definition: An external service vendor behind an integration (Stripe, Autentique, DocuSign, Soundcharts, WhatsApp Cloud).
disallowedUsages: mixing 'provider' (vendor) with 'platform' (where the artist is)
glossary.idNamespace: provider = enum key of the vendor (stripe, autentique, docusign, soundcharts, whatsapp)

glossary.definition: A configured connection between a tenant and a provider (integrations / oauth_connections).
disallowedUsages: 'integration' for integration tests in domain names
glossary.idNamespace: integrationId = integrations.id; oauthConnectionId = oauth_connections.id

glossary.definition: A measured value (followers, streams) captured as a snapshot (artist_metric_snapshots).
disallowedUsages: estimated values presented as measured metrics
glossary.idNamespace: artist_metric_snapshots.id; metric keys are English snake_case

glossary.definition: A derived, AI/automation-produced interpretation of metrics (analytics-insights automation), never a raw metric.
disallowedUsages: 'insight' for raw data

'composicao'` fallback always evaluated to `dto.tipo_obra` in real usage — `registro-musicas.mapper.ts`'s `formToObraPayload()` never sends a `type` key at all, only `tipo_obra` · Both stay live as genuinely distinct concepts (catalog origin vs. ABRAMUS/ECAD work-type classification) — fallback removed, `type` now defaults to `'composicao'` when absent, `tipo_obra` never feeds it · **DONE (2026-09-21) as a BUG fix, not a product decision** — code trace proved 100%-reproducible technical authority (the fallback always fired in production, conflating two concepts), matching this mission's instruction not to declare NEEDS_PRODUCT_DECISION when code/usage determine technical authority; migration `20260921000001_FixWorksTypeTipoObraCollision` defensively corrects any `type IN ('autoral','referencia')` back to `'composicao'` (DEV: 0 affected rows)

Not present in `CreatePhonogramDto` (would be rejected by `forbidNonWhitelisted`), zero writers anywhere; declared `ro()`/`importable:false` in `PHONOGRAMS_CONTRACT`, so the Reports bulk-import engine can't reach them either (`ImportMapperService` resolves uploaded headers only against `importableColumns`) · Dropped — superseded by `participacao` (jsonb, the real form's own field) · **DONE (2026-09-23)**, migration `20260923000002_DropDeadPhonogramsLegacyParticipantColumns` — plain `DROP COLUMN`, zero data loss (0 non-null on all 3, confirmed on DEV)

`compositor` looked equally dead by the same form/DTO trace (`ObraFormModal.tsx` only ever populates `compositores`) — **this session initially dropped it by mistake** · Both stay live — **not** a naming collision: `compositor` is `col()` (importable) in `WORKS_CONTRACT`, and the Reports import-commit engine writes raw SQL `INSERT`s directly against `importableColumns`, bypassing `CreateWorkDto` entirely. A pre-existing guard test (`work-participants-normalization.spec.ts`, "mantém `compositor`... writer real via bulk-import (Reports)") caught the mistake on the first full test run, before the migration reached DEV · **DONE (2026-09-23) — self-corrected before any DEV impact.** Root-cause lesson for the rest of this audit: a field's "zero writers" claim must be checked against the Reports bulk-import engine's `importableColumns` (derived from each contract's `col()`/`ro()` distinction), not just the real UI form + DTO layer — those are two independent writer paths

**Severe, independent, pre-existing bug** found while tracing `interpretes`' live replacement: `FonogramaFormModal.tsx` has always sent participacao as an OBJECT (`{ produtorFonografico, interprete, musicoAcompanhante }`, each an array), confirmed by direct component inspection — `@IsArray()` rejected this on every real submit with participant data, verified empirically (`plainToInstance`+`validate()` with the real payload shape reproduces `"participacao must be an array"`). No real fonograma submission with participants has ever succeeded · New `ParticipacaoDto`/`ParticipanteDto` (`@IsObject() @ValidateNested() @Type(...)`, matching the codebase's established nested-DTO pattern from `update-company-settings.dto.ts`) · **DONE (2026-09-23) — real functional bug fix, not a naming issue per se, surfaced by this audit.** `entities.ts`'s `PhonogramEntity.participacao` retyped to the real shape (`PhonogramParticipacao`, not `unknown[]`); `release-readiness.service.ts`'s interpreter requirement and `catalog-metadata-validator.automation.ts`'s AI-skill `performers`/`producers` input (a hard requirement of `validateCatalogMetadataValidatorInput()` for `type=recording`) both rewired to read the real `participacao.interprete`/`.produtorFonografico`, restoring invariants that had been silently satisfied by always-empty data before

concepts.notes: Current state: **RESOLVED (2026-09-23) — overturned by fresh evidence, not a genuine two-domain merge.** `party_role` is not a competing EN enum: migration `20260913000001_RenameSharePartyFieldsToEnglish` already renamed the PT `papel` (role/function) column directly to `party_role` — it already *is* the PT "função" concept, just under an English column name, per this repo's established boundary-translation precedent. Real domain confirmed by `entity-validators.ts`'s `isInterpreterRole`/`isPublisherRole`/`isProducerRole` substring predicates (`'interpret'`, `'produtor'`, `'editora'`, `'cantor'`, etc.) and by `shares.service.ts::baseQb()`, which already implements `s.party_role = :partyRole` correctly. `shares.type` by contrast has **zero writers anywhere** in `shares.service.ts`'s create/update paths (full-file grep) and was 100%-null on DEV (1/1 rows) — a write-dead phantom column, not a second live domain. The apparent "two domains" in the prior entry were an artifact of one bug: `apps/web/.../GestaoShares.tsx` had a filter dropdown literally labeled "Função" with real `party_role`-domain values (`interprete`/`compositor`/`produtor`/`editora`/`gravadora`/`empresario`) wired to send `filters.type` (the dead column) instead of `filters.party_role` (the live, already-correct server-side filter) · Blocker/resolution: **DONE (2026-09-23)** — frontend-only fix (`useSharesPaginated.ts`, `GestaoShares.tsx`): renamed the hook param `type`→`partyRole`, filter key `type`→`party_role`; no schema/service change needed since the server-side `party_role` filter was already correct. `shares.type` itself is now proven fully dead (never written, never correctly read) but its physical drop is **deliberately deferred** (not blocked) as a separate, lower-risk follow-up migration — dropping it is not required to close this bug, and bundling an unrelated schema change into a pure filter-wiring fix would violate this mission's own scope-minimality discipline
